# BrainLift

> Study app that turns photos of notes, PDFs, typed notes or a topic into quizzes and flashcard decks, then helps students remember them with spaced repetition and practice decks built from their own mistakes.

BrainLift is for high school, college, nursing, medical, law and language students and certification candidates. It is available for iPhone and iPad (App Store id 6749842070) and as a web app at https://getbrainlift.app. It launched in March 2026 and is built by an independent developer.

## Features

- **Photo, PDF, text or topic to quiz**: Photograph notes or a textbook page, upload a PDF, paste notes or name a topic. Choose difficulty and question count.
- **Flashcard decks**: Generated from the same material, one idea per card.
- **Practice my mistakes**: Questions missed on a quiz become a flashcard deck with answers and explanations.
- **Spaced repetition**: Rate each card after answering; the schedule decides when it comes back.
- **AI tutor chat**: Explanations, worked examples, charts and diagrams.
- **Sharing**: Send a quiz or deck to classmates by link or QR code.
- **Habit features**: XP, 10 levels, daily quests, streaks and achievements.

## How AI is used

Submitted content is processed by third-party AI providers (OpenAI and Google Gemini) to generate study material. AI-generated content can contain mistakes; users are told to check important answers against their course materials.

## Pricing

- **Free**: all core features with monthly usage limits.
- **Premium**: $6.99 per month, $49.99 per year, or $2.99 per week (US App Store prices). Raises limits and unlocks additional features.

## Platforms

- iPhone and iPad (iOS 15.1 or later)
- Web browser
- No Android app yet
